name: Knowledge
summary: For people whose knowledge is scattered across notes, manuals and PDFs: build a small, well-defined library on your own Windows computer, search a keyword and see which source and which passage of the original it comes from. Files stay on your machine; this is a prototype in a personal pilot.

name: WorldQuant Alpha Research Toolkit
summary: An engineered workflow for WorldQuant BRAIN Alpha research: candidate generation, multi-metric evaluation, and human-approved submissions.

name: AI Application Development Study Repo
summary: Learning notes and milestone projects in AI application development: LangChain, RAG, LangGraph, evaluation, and engineering practice.

name: Hengcang
summary: For households with several accounts and currencies: pool everything into one ledger and see how far the Growth, Balanced and Defensive groups are from their targets. The web app lets you try a sample ledger without signing up; your own ledger needs an account. The Android app is open source.
home_summary: A multi-currency household ledger: see how far three asset groups are from target. The sample needs no sign-up; your own ledger does.

name: Investment Dashboards
summary: Two public read-only dashboards: index allocation and recurring-investment watch, plus A-share short-term money flow. Scheduled jobs refresh the data snapshots that ship with the code.
home_summary: Read-only snapshots of index allocation and A-share fund flows.

name: Character Atelier
summary: For people who write novels or draw original characters: turn a character's looks, personality and background into one complete profile card. A few choices are enough, and trying it needs no sign-up; saving it to your own library needs an account.
home_summary: For novelists and original-character artists: turn looks, personality and background into one profile card. No sign-up to try.
